Yet the same object seen by different persons, from the same standpoint, creates different impressions.

arxiv-2303-14634.title: Resource Efficiency vs Performance Isolation Tradeoff in Network Slicing Thanks: .
arxiv-2303-14634.creator: Panagiotis Nikolaidis and Asim Zoulkarni and John Baras
arxiv-2303-14634.description: Abstract We consider the tradeoff between resource efficiency and performance isolation that emerges when multiplexing the resource demands of Network Slices (NSs). On the one hand, multiplexing allows the use of idle resources, which increases resource efficiency. On the other hand, the performance of each NS becomes susceptible to traffic surges in other NSs, which degrades performance isolation.

arxiv-2409-06504.title: Discovery of young, oxygen-rich supernova remnants in PHANGS-MUSE galaxies
arxiv-2409-06504.creator: T. Kravtsov, J. P. Anderson, H. Kuncarayakti, K. Maeda, S. Mattila
arxiv-2409-06504.description: Abstract Context. Supernova remnants (SNRs) are the late stages of supernovae before their merging into the surrounding medium. Oxygen-rich supernova remnants represent a rare subtype with strong visible light oxygen emission. Aims. We present a new method to detect SNRs exploiting the capabilities of modern visible-light integral-field units based on the shapes of the SNR emission lines. Methods.

arxiv-2412-20953.title: GASLITEing the Retrieval: Exploring Vulnerabilities in Dense Embedding-based Search
arxiv-2412-20953.creator: Matan Ben-Tov, Mahmood Sharif
arxiv-2412-20953.description: Abstract . Dense embedding-based text retrieval—retrieval of relevant passages from corpora via deep learning encodings—has emerged as a powerful method attaining state-of-the-art search results and popularizing Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG). Still, like other search methods, embedding-based retrieval may be susceptible to search-engine optimization (SEO) attacks, where adversaries promote malicious content by introducing adversarial passages to corpora.

arxiv-2504-17025.title: Optimizing LLMs for Italian: Reducing Token Fertility and Enhancing Efficiency Through Vocabulary Adaptation
arxiv-2504-17025.creator: Luca Moroni, Giovanni Puccetti *, Pere-Lluis Huguet Cabot, Andrei Stefan Bejgu, Edoardo Barba, Alessio Miaschi, Felice Dell’Orletta, Andrea Esuli, Roberto Navigli
arxiv-2504-17025.description: Abstract The number of pretrained Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasing steadily, though the majority are designed predominantly for the English language. While state-of-the-art LLMs can handle other languages, due to language contamination or some degree of multilingual pretraining data, they are not optimized for non-English languages, leading to inefficient encoding (high token "fertility") and slower inference speed.

arxiv-2507-10625.title: Strategic Control of Drug-Resistant HIV: Multi-Strain Modeling with Diagnosis, Adherence, and Treatment Switching
arxiv-2507-10625.creator: Ashish Poonia, Siddhartha P. Chakrabarty
arxiv-2507-10625.description: Abstract A central challenge in Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) public health policy lies in determining whether to universally expand treatment access, despite the risk of sub-optimal adherence and consequent drug resistance, or to adopt a more strategic allocation of resources that balances treatment coverage with adherence support.

pmc-11514508.description: BACKGROUNDAccording to current statistics, renal cancer accounts for 3% of all cancers worldwide. Increasing evidence has shown an association between immune infiltration in RCC and clinical outcomes.

pmc-12405087.title: Reconsidering early RRT in leptospirosis AKI: a question of timing criteria
pmc-12405087.creator: Pei-Chen Wu, Thomas Tao-Min Huang
pmc-12405087.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ly valuable given the logistical constraints of conducting randomized controlled trials in this context. However, we propose an alternative interpretation of the findings: the observed adverse outcomes in the early RRT group may not be inherent to early dialysis initiation per se, but rather reflect a fundamental limitation in using KDIGO Stage 3 as a surrogate trigger for RRT initiation in leptospirosis. The authors define “early RRT” as initiation within 48 h of hospital admission among patients with KDIGO Stage 3 AKI.

pmc-12720106.title: Unveiling dual-functional umami peptides with antioxidant effects from eggshell membrane byproducts: A machine learning-guided approach integrating molecular simulation and quantum chemistry
pmc-12720106.creator: Lingjiao Zhu, Jingyan Li, Vincent Guyonnet, Yang Xu, Qiwei Dai, Miaoyan Zhang, Hongxun Wang, Yang Yi, Wei Xu
pmc-12720106.description: This study developed an efficient strategy for exploring novel dual-functional umami peptides with antioxidant activity from eggshell membrane (ESM), a protein-rich byproduct of the food industry, by integrating machine learning, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, quantum chemistry and in vitro validations. Three novel peptides (CDDDF, WHDCHR, and CWDVYR) were identified from in silico ESM hydrolysates.

pmc-13070697.title: Simultaneous bilateral patellar tendon rupture: a case report on successful repair with gracilis autograft augmentation
pmc-13070697.creator: Luis Henrique Longo, Marcos Paulo Tercziany Vanzin, Luca Eiji Sohn Sato, Luis Antonio de Ridder Bauer, Camille Midori Okuyama, Rolmerson Robson Filho Fontes
pmc-13070697.description: Simultaneous bilateral patellar tendon rupture is an exceedingly rare injury, often linked to systemic comorbidities. This report presents the case of a 31-year-old active male with a history of hypothyroidism, asthma, and chronic anabolic steroid use who sustained bilateral ruptures while running. He underwent urgent surgical repair using intratendinous sutures augmented with a double-bundle ipsilateral gracilis autograft.
